name: compare_climate_periods
description: Compare the same climate variable between two time periods, either by loading registered climate layers internally or by comparing two already-loaded climate layer artifacts.

variable.description: Climate or hazard variable to compare. Examples: 'extreme_heat_days', 'tasmax', 'heat_index'. Required if climate_artifact_a and climate_artifact_b are not provided.

region_name.description: Region name for the comparison. Examples: 'Fiji', 'Tonga', 'Melanesia'. Required if climate artifacts are not provided.

period_a.description: Baseline or earlier period. Examples: '2050s', '2050', 'historical'. Required if climate_artifact_a is not provided.

period_b.description: Comparison or later period. Examples: '2060s', '2100s'. Required if climate_artifact_b is not provided.

climate_artifact_a.description: Optional already-loaded climate layer artifact for period_a.

climate_artifact_b.description: Optional already-loaded climate layer artifact for period_b.

value_column.description: Optional numeric column to compare. If omitted, the function uses the value_column metadata from the input artifacts.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing the comparison layer.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

comparison_columns.description: Names of period_a value column, period_b value column, absolute change column, percent change column, and change direction column.

summary.description: Summary statistics for the period comparison.

provenance.description: Information about parent layers and comparison method.
